title: Mail: add prometheus metrics module and /metrics route
description: Mail crate has zero metrics. Add prometheus=0.14 to Cargo.toml. Create crates/mail/src/metrics.rs with: JMAP_REQUESTS_TOTAL counter (label: method), JMAP_REQUEST_DURATION_SECONDS histogram (label: method), EMAIL_QUERY_RESULTS gauge. Instrument jmap_api_handler in server.rs to record per-method latency. Add GET /metrics route to build_router() (public, no auth - metrics reveal no sensitive data). The /metrics endpoint uses prometheus::TextEncoder.
